title: [NSClient 3.0.0.2-Master] Problem using NSClient 3.0.0.2 from the latest Master version
symptom: When NSClient version 3.0.0.2 is installed on another phone and the master profile is imported, the Nightscout page crashes and needs to be restarted to get it working again and pause the NSClient sync in the NSClient 3.0.0.2 app. Even without importing the profile, after putting the data of the Nightscout page, a few minutes later NSClient returns an error and the Nightscout page crashes.
cause: The thread suggests it may be related to Calibrations processing, which is resolved in dev.
fix: The maintainer advises not to import master data into NSClient, just configure it for NS address. The issue is believed to be resolved in dev.
evidence_quote: I believe this is related to Calibrations processsing which is resolved in dev now
